selectionRule: Review this fixed ten-destination batch as a whole. Do not remove a candidate because its independent label disagrees with the engine. Sources must be independent of the scoring implementation and controlled by a public park, environmental authority, or official national destination organisation.

candidates.name: Yosemite, United States
candidates.label: July to October
candidates.basis: The National Park Service says most trails except the highest elevations normally have little or no snow by early July and remain so until the first significant snow, typically in October.

candidates.name: Grand Canyon, United States
candidates.label: March to May and September to early November
candidates.basis: The official park trip planner identifies spring and fall as offering some of the best inner-canyon hiking weather and specifies March, April, October and early November in the canyon, with April, May, September and October on the rims.

source.title: Grand Canyon National Park Trip Planner

candidates.name: Mount Rainier, United States
candidates.label: mid-July to September
candidates.basis: The National Park Service defines July through September as the summer hiking season for the Wonderland Trail and says it is typically mostly snow-free from mid-July through the end of September.

source.title: Wilderness Permit Frequently Asked Questions — Mount Rainier

candidates.name: Denali, United States
candidates.label: June to August
candidates.basis: The National Park Service backcountry guidance treats June through August as the normal hiking period, while May and September are colder and mountain snow is more likely.

candidates.name: Jasper, Canada
candidates.label: early July to mid-September
candidates.basis: Parks Canada states that alpine trails are typically snow-free from early July to mid-September and identifies that period as suitable for exploring alpine trails.

candidates.name: Larapinta Trail, Australia
candidates.label: April to September
candidates.basis: The Northern Territory Parks and Wildlife trail material explicitly defines April through September inclusive as the recommended walking season and warns that dangerous heat can still occur.

candidates.name: Cradle Mountain, Australia
candidates.label: October to May
candidates.basis: Tasmania Parks and Wildlife defines 1 October through 31 May as the Overland Track summer booking season; winter walking requires specialist preparation for strong wind, heavy rain, snow and blizzards.

candidates.name: Landmannalaugar, Iceland
candidates.label: late June to mid-September
candidates.basis: Iceland's Environment Agency ties summer access to the opening of the highland roads and operates the Landmannalaugar access system from about 20 June through mid-September.

candidates.name: Jotunheimen, Norway
candidates.label: late June to early September
candidates.basis: Norway's official travel guide describes the main Besseggen hiking season as a short period from late June to early September, with the regular boat connection operating across the same summer window.

candidates.name: Daisetsuzan, Japan
candidates.label: late June to September
candidates.basis: Japan's Ministry of the Environment states that Daisetsuzan's climbing season runs from late June through September because spring arrives late, autumn arrives early and first summit snow commonly occurs in mid-September.
